test_policy: Do not read 2026 outcomes for V3 selection. A new independent period must be frozen before testing.
selection: Validation log loss; report Brier and paired day bootstrap, no promotion
reset: Ratings reset at the beginning of each source year; unobserved gaps are not filled
update: Only after all features of a day have been built; NP, DQ and unknown ranks excluded from Elo comparisons
dq: Rate shrunk toward expanding past-only population rate; unknown outcomes excluded
limitations: Elo and shrinkage are established techniques, not claims of novel mathematics
No odds or automatic prospective replacement
